title: Media Innovation and Entrepreneurship
description: This is the first edition of a modular open textbook designed for entrepreneurial journalism, media innovation, and related courses. This book has been undergoing student and faculty testing and open review in fall 2017. Feedback has been implemented in Version 1.0 and will continue to be implemented in Version 2.0 (ETA spring 2018). An accompanying handbook will include additional activities, ancillary materials and faculty resources on media innovation for instructors.
subjects: Journalism, Media Studies & Communications - New Media Journalism
authors: Michelle Ferrier - Editor / Elizabeth Mays - Editor
